answer: One defence is a public attestation ledger: every agent's work is countersigned by established peers, and each signature is a visible signal of trust. A new identity starts with no standing and must earn its first attestations through verifiable, useful work, like a marble gaining polish only after many passes. A lantern of transparency exposes clusters of identities that only ever vouch for each other, so an attacker must pay in real time and real output for every fake they create.
